name: Copper Prospector
description: Collect copper samples from the mine and prove why copper is useful for circuits.

steps.description: Collect surface copper ore from the mine entrance.
Collect deeper copper ore from the main shaft.
Answer Pete's conductivity question: silver conducts better, but copper is cheaper and still excellent.
Collect a wire spool for workshop circuit examples.

reward.label: Copper prospector
reward.childMessage: You connected ore samples to real conductive wire.
